questions.q: When is the inbox checked?
questions.gold: Weekdays at 8 a.m. and 1 p.m. Mountain

questions.q: A member asks you to book a meeting room for 5 hours tomorrow. May you book it yourself?
A member asks, 30 hours before arrival, to register 4 guests. Is Keisha's approval needed?
A member asks, 10 hours before arrival, to add 3 guests. May you add them yourself?
questions.gold: No; more than 2 guests at short notice needs Keisha

questions.q: A member asks, 10 hours before arrival, to add 2 guests. May you add them yourself?
A Day Pass member asks to book the podcast studio. May you book it?
A member cancels a room booking 90 minutes before the start; there is no outage. Are they charged?
A member cancels 1 hour before the start because the building's internet is down. Are they charged?
A projector borrowed this morning is still out at 7 p.m. What do you do?
questions.gold: Email the member a reminder and copy Keisha

questions.q: A visitor asks for a member's desk location. What do you do?
questions.gold: Don't give it; call the member to come to reception

questions.q: Someone reports a water leak. What do you tell them, and what do you do yourself, in what order?
questions.gold: Tell them not to touch electrical equipment near it; call facilities (303) 555-0187 yourself; then message Keisha

questions.q: Is sending Keisha the unpaid-invoices list at exactly 12:00 on Monday on time?
An invoice has been unpaid for 15 days. Does it go on Monday's list?
When is the transport inbox checked?
A registered parent writes 8 hours ahead asking to change tomorrow's stop for one day. May you change it?
A registered parent asks in writing 2 days ahead to change the stop permanently. May you approve it?
No authorized adult is at the stop for a primary student. What happens?
questions.gold: The student returns to school and you call the guardian

questions.q: A secondary student whose guardian signed the annual permission wants to get off alone. Allowed?
A parent reports their child didn't arrive home. What do you tell the parent, and whom do you notify, how fast?
questions.gold: Tell them to call the route driver immediately; notify Laura Méndez and the principal's office in less than 10 minutes

questions.q: Who must send the payment receipt, and by when are fees paid?
questions.gold: The guardian sends it; fees are paid before the 5th of each month

questions.q: A grandparent who is not a registered guardian asks for the bus's live location. May you share it?
During an emergency, may the principal be copied on a parent email?
Is Laura Méndez the principal?
questions.gold: No; she is the transport coordinator

questions.q: Is sending Laura the delay report at 14:00 sharp on Friday on time?
When and where is the club fest?
questions.gold: Saturday 6 June from 14:00 at the sports field by the lake

questions.q: A parent brings a cake to the clubhouse on Saturday morning. Is that within the arrangement?
May someone bring a whipped-cream cake?
How much does the parents' council pay for the bouncy castle?
Are glass bottles allowed on the field?
What must nobody tell coach Bernd about, and when is it?
By when must teardown be finished?
Does a 5-year-old get a free drink?
How many schools are merged into how many, and by when?
By how many pupils has enrolment fallen?
How much of the building cost does the national grant cover?
A pupil lives 3.5 km from school. Do they get the free school bus?
Can a resident still submit a comment on December 20?
What exactly did the mayor say?
questions.gold: 「子どもたちが多様な仲間と学べる環境をつくりたい」
accept: 子どもたちが多様な仲間と学べる環境をつくりたい
